scenario_text: A particle of fixed energy approaches a rectangular potential barrier whose height exceeds the particle energy. The probability of the particle emerging on the far side is measured as a function of barrier thickness. The experimenter varies the barrier width and records the transmission fraction. This probes how evanescent penetration governs quantum leakage through a classically forbidden region.
